title: Viral Metagenomics utilising SMART-9N Amplification
author: Ingra Claro Morales
materials: Add the following reagents to the reaction and mix by inversion: Component Volume 1 Binding Buffer from the MagMAX kit 520 µL 2 Magnetic beads from the MagMAX kit 20 µL 3 Proteinase K from the MagMAX kit 10 µL 4 Total 860 µL
To aid with sample elution, transfer the tubes to a thermomixer and incubate at 65 °C for 00:05:00 at 1000 rpm, °C, .

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of sample into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Enzymatic Treatment
steps.instruction: Transfer 300 µL of supernatant from each sample into a separate 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and add 10 µL of HLSAN enzyme, then vortex for 3 seconds.

steps.title: Incubation Sequence
steps.instruction: Perform a series of incubations to process the samples.

substeps.instruction: Incubate on a thermomixer at 37 °C for 10 minutes at 1000 rpm.
Incubate on a thermomixer at 65 °C for 5 minutes at 1000 rpm.
Incubate/mix on a HulaMixer TM at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the sample using magnetic beads and a series of washes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2 mL of fresh 80% ethanol in nuclease-free water per sample.
Briefly spin down tubes and pellet on a magnetic rack for at least 5 minutes until the supernatant is clear and colorless; pipette off the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of MagMAX kit Wash Buffer, gently mix by inverting, spin down, and pellet on the magnetic rack for at least 2 minutes; pipette off the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of 80% ethanol, gently mix by inverting, spin down, and pellet on the magnetic rack for at least 2 minutes; pipette off the supernatant.
Add 500 µL of 80% ethanol, gently mix by inverting, spin down, and pellet on the magnetic rack for at least 2 minutes; pipette off the supernatant.
Allow the pellet to dry for 2 minutes (do not dry to the point of cracking).

steps.title: Bead Resuspension and Elution
steps.instruction: Recover the purified material from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet by adding 20 µL of nuclease-free water and pipette mixing.
Pellet the beads on a magnet for at least 1 minute until the eluate is clear and colorless.
Remove and retain the eluate in a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: DNA Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the PCR products using the Qubit TM dsDNA HS Assay Kit on a Qubit Fluorometer (or alternatives: Promega Quantus TM Fluorometer with QuantiFluor dsDNA System [Cat: E6150, E2671] or DIYNAFLUOR).

steps.title: AMPure XP Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a secondary cleanup using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 1X AMPure XP beads to the sample, mix gently, and incubate on a HulaMixer TM at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Pellet beads on a magnet and remove the supernatant.
Wash beads with 150 µL of 80% Ethanol (do not disturb pellet), then remove and discard ethanol. Repeat this wash once more.
Spin down the pellet, remove excess ethanol, and allow the pellet to lose its shine.
Resuspend the pellet in 20 µL of Nuclease-free water by flicking the tube and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Pellet on a magnet and transfer the clear supernatant into a fresh 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: First-Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Prepare the reverse transcription reaction and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Combine the following per reaction in a 0.2 mL PCR tube: 1 µL dNTP mix (10 mM), 1 µL RLB RT 9N (12 µM), and 10 µL RNA (Total 12 µL).
Prepare a second master mix per reaction: 4 µL SSIV Buffer (5X), 1 µL DTT (100 µM), 1 µL RNase OUT, 1 µL SSIV RT (200 units/µL), and 1 µL RLB SSP (12 µM) (Total 8 µL).
Add 8 µL of the master mix to 12 µL of the annealed RNA.
Incubate at 65 °C for 5 minutes and then snap cool on ice.

steps.title: cDNA Annealing and Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction on a thermocycler using the following program:

substeps.instruction: 42 °C for 90 minutes
70 °C for 10 minutes
4 °C Hold

steps.title: SMART-9N Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification using the following master mix and thermocycler settings.

substeps.instruction: Combine per reaction: 12.5 µL Q5 High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix, 1 µL RLB PCR (10 µM), 9 µL Nuclease-Free Water, and 2.5 µL cDNA (Total 25 µL).
Run thermocycler: 1 cycle of 98 °C for 45 seconds; 30 cycles of 98 °C for 15 seconds, 62 °C for 15 seconds, and 65 °C for 5 minutes; 1 cycle of 65 °C for 10 minutes; 4 °C Hold.

steps.title: Sequencing Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare samples for sequencing using ONT Native Barcoding Kit (SQK-NBD114.24 / SQ-NBD114.96) for multiple samples or ONT Ligation Sequencing kit (SQK-LSK114) for single samples, following manufacturer protocols. Use PromethION for metagenomics, or MinION/GridION for smaller inputs.
